setup:
rabbitmqadmin exchanges declare --name orders --type direct --durable true
rabbitmqadmin queues declare --name orders-paid --type classic --durable true
rabbitmqadmin queues declare --name orders-cancelled --type classic --durable true
rabbitmqadmin bindings declare --source orders --destination-type queue --destination orders-paid --routing-key payed
rabbitmqadmin bindings declare --source orders --destination-type queue --destination orders-cancelled --routing-key cancelled
